policies.acceptance: Design accepted at Step 3 (comm-003999). Plans P1-P10 accepted at Step 5 (comm-004003) with SEF-PLAN-001 (high), SEF-PLAN-002 (mid) and SEF-PLAN-003 (mid) resolved and no open findings.
policies.evidencePolicy: A behavioral record is a test-runner command (swift test ..., bun test ..., vitest run ..., or mise run <task containing test>) with exit code 0 and every count > 0. For XCTest record the 'Executed N tests, 0 failures' line with N > 0. mise run web:check is not a behavioral record. bun test src and vitest run are recorded separately. An env-gated skip is never evidence; live suites record only the XCTest count of the positive run. Every command is teed into the plan's evidence directory and each record gives the complete log path and the final exit status.
policies.evidenceLayout: Evidence lives under tmp/search-engine-fusion/<planId-prefix> (P1..P10), gitignored by tmp/. A retry attempt may use an attempt subdirectory inside the plan's own directory. A plan never writes another plan's evidence directory.
policies.editProtocol: Index 'Edit protocol': pre/post shasum per edit in tmp/search-engine-fusion/<P#>/hashes.txt, an immutable intent snapshot intent.md, drift handling, edit only own writePaths, peer compile/lint failures are not blockers (retry after peers land, cross-plan fixes go to P10), no git write operations, no worktrees or branches, do not touch .riela/, each plan updates only its own progress log in its own plan file.
policies.artifactPolicy: artifactRoots are copied unchanged from the accepted plans: tmp/search-engine-fusion/<P#> for every plan, web/dist for P8 and P10 (vite build from mise run web:check), and web/src-tauri/target for P10 (mise run tauri:check). All are gitignored. Authored files (sources, tests, compose files, mise.toml, README.md, plan files) are never artifact roots.
policies.dockerPolicy: macOS Docker runs through colima; use mise run search:meilisearch:up and search:up (both depend on search:docker) rather than raw docker compose. P9 pins a getmeili/meilisearch v1.x.y tag (v1.10 or later) and records the tag, RepoDigest, pull command and exit code in its Progress Log. If Docker is unavailable, record 'blocked: docker unavailable' with the exact error, never passed.
policies.japaneseGate: If the live Japanese query fails on the pinned stock Meilisearch image, P9 records the failure, tag and response as a blocker for P10 and user-qa; no plan switches engines or tokenizer settings ad hoc (design F3).
policies.sanctionedExistingTestEdits: Only three existing-test edits are allowed: P3 the adapters expectation in SearchEngineFactoryTests.testSettingsValidationAndNormalizedTargets; P4 removal of AgentSearchNotesRoutingTests.testIncludeLinkedKeepsFullTextRouting; P6 the searchNotes selection expectation (and optional fixture) in KaibaTypedOperationContractTests. NoteRetrievalFusionTests, KaibaAgentToolboxTests, ElasticsearchSearchEngineTests and ElasticsearchLiveTests stay unmodified.

reviewContext.issueReference: No GitHub issue. Inline workflowInput 'Search engine: engine-seeded graph search and search_notes, unified reranking across agent/engine/FTS/graph results, and a lightweight non-JVM engine adapter (Meilisearch first)' (workflowExecutionId opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-268; design accepted comm-003999; plans accepted comm-004003).
reviewContext.userProblem: The optional search engine is only reachable through engineSearchNotes, relatedNotes and the agent search_notes tool with include_linked=false. Graph search, the agent's graph search and agentic grounding rank FTS hits only, each path fuses differently, and the only adapter (Elasticsearch) needs a JVM, which is heavy for a single-user desktop setup.
requiredOutcomes: F1: with an engine attached, GraphQL searchNotes with includeLinked true, the agent search_notes tool (both include_linked values) and AIAgenticSearch grounding use engine hits fused with FTS hits as seeds (PPR expansion seeded from fused hits) through NoteService.retrieveNotes; with no engine, an engine error, or any short-cut condition the results equal today's searchNotes / FTS output exactly.

F2: one deterministic engine-neutral reranker NoteRetrievalReranker.fuse (weighted RRF, k=60, ties by noteId ascending, direct tier before neighbor tier, dedupe by noteId, per-list cap 1000, 16 lists, 200 engine candidates, fused window 1000) with provenance (sources and reasons), used by graph search, the agent tool, agentic grounding and the Meilisearch adapter's sub-query fusion; no LLM call.
Access: every engine candidate is re-checked against the store with today's scope predicates (eligibleSearchCandidateIds) before it enters the reranker.

Provenance exposed additively: GraphQL NoteSearchResult.provenance: NoteRetrievalProvenance! (derived full-text/graph-neighbor for FTS results), KaibaClient optional provenance, and per-result provenance plus retrieval=search-engine in agent search_notes output only when the engine was used.

F3/F4: a Meilisearch adapter behind the unchanged SearchEngine protocol (index <prefix>-notes-v1, identity meilisearch:<target>/<uid>, task-based writes with bounded waits, multi-search ontology expansion and related-notes composition fused in-adapter, jpn locale, maxTotalHits 2000, sanitized errors), registered in SearchEngineFactory with auth modes none/apiKey and a new descriptor auth-mode rule; settings, hot-swap, test connection, config lock, outbox and backfill reused unchanged.

F5: docker/meilisearch/compose.yaml (pinned tag, 127.0.0.1:7700, no master key), mise tasks search:meilisearch:up/down/status/test-live reusing search:docker, an env-gated MeilisearchLive suite including a Japanese query, and an AppServer runtime hot-swap test.

F6: README engine choice and resource profile, Meilisearch config and tasks, restricted API key advice, engine-seeded search with FTS fallback; command.md and base design pointers (already updated in the design step).

Gates: mise run build, full swift test, mise run lint, bun test src, vitest run, mise run web:check, mise run tauri:check, mise run search:test-live and mise run search:meilisearch:test-live all pass with positive counts.
nonGoals: LLM rerank, embeddings or vector search.
Fusion for searchNotes with includeLinked false, the NoteSearchPopup link picker, kaiba search, memo search and long-term-memory recall (stay on FTS).
Changes to engineSearchNotes or relatedNotes service behavior.
Typesense and Manticore adapters (compared in design F3, not built).
Engine capability flags on the SearchEngine protocol.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md; Swift files under 1000 lines; swiftlint clean on touched files.
Extend the existing adapter and retrieval fusion; do not redesign accepted parts.
Engine disabled means identical behavior and results to today; existing tests keep passing unchanged except the three sanctioned edits.
No LLM call in retrieval; boundary grep over search-engine, reranker and Meilisearch files returns nothing.
Callers depend only on the engine-neutral protocol; Meilisearch specifics stay in Sources/AppCore/Meilisearch*.swift.
Elasticsearch adapter requests, index name and indexIdentity unchanged; the transport moves to SearchEngineHTTPTransport.swift behind type aliases.
No secrets in config, docs, logs or commits; no machine-local absolute paths.
Do not touch the untracked .riela/ directory or unrelated files.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Single async entry point retrieveNotes with an all-or-nothing FTS fallback: a thrown engine error is the unhealthy signal, so there is no per-call health probe and no partial engine contribution.
The reranker is skipped on single-source paths and its tie-break is noteId ascending, so FTS-only grounding produces exactly today's order (F2 rule 5).
Weights: engine 1.0 and FTS 1.0 per query; grounding full query 2.0 and terms 1.0; graph-neighbor 1.0 in the neighbor tier; RRF k stays 60; coverage is reported, not a cross-source sort key.

Meilisearch chosen over Typesense (full index in RAM, mandatory API key) and Manticore (n-gram-only CJK) for built-in Japanese segmentation in the stock image; the live Japanese query is the acceptance gate.

Capability gaps (no more_like_this, no clause boosts) are closed inside the adapter with multi-search sub-queries fused by the shared reranker, so the protocol and Elasticsearch adapter stay unchanged.
Factory enforces descriptor authModes, so Meilisearch rejects basic with searchEngine.authMode before any network call.
intentionalTradeoffs: Fused paging with offset > 0 is not prefix-stable (accepted at design review; no in-repo caller pages includeLinked=true).
Agent search_notes reports retrieval=full-text when an engine is attached but the tag filter does not resolve or no library is reachable (results empty either way).
KaibaClient provenance selection may fail against an older server; client and server ship together and the client field is optional.
Meilisearch facets come from the text query only and are refinement hints.
Switching back to a previously used adapter re-backfills it; orphaned documents are harmless because of the store re-check.
supportedEdgeCases: No engine, engine error, empty query, limit <= 0, or window above 1000: retrieveNotes returns exactly searchNotes(...) with provenance nil.
Engine hits in an unreachable library, another owner's notebook, the long-term-memory notebook, a pending ingest, outside tag/class/created-at filters, or deleted are dropped by the store re-check.
Engine-only seed with includeLinked true yields its linked neighbor with graph-neighbor provenance.
Agentic grounding falls back to full FTS grounding after the first engine failure, with an identical context document.

Meilisearch: index_already_exists counts as success, invalid_document upsert batches are resubmitted per document, pending tasks time out as unavailable, note ids outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] map to x-<sha256>, filter values are escaped, secrets never appear in error text.
Hot-swap from Elasticsearch to Meilisearch through settings reload changes the slot identity and is seen by scoped service copies.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Japanese segmentation failure on the stock Meilisearch image: recorded as a blocker in user-qa, not worked around.
Older-server compatibility for the KaibaClient provenance selection.
tauri:check off macOS and live suites without a running local Docker (recorded as blocked with the exact error, never passed).
residualRisks: Low: Meilisearch Japanese segmentation and _formatted/attributesToRetrieve behavior are unproven until the P9 live run; a blocker path is defined.
Low: P1 places NoteRetrievalOutcome in NoteRetrievalReranker.swift while the design text names NoteService+EngineSeededRetrieval.swift; the public shape is identical.
Low: P7's wave-3 factory test record may hit transient compile failures from peers editing AppCore; Edit protocol rule 5 covers retry.
